# Know Your Meme

> > Encyclopedia and documentation hub for internet culture, viral memes, TikTok trends, and social media phenomena across platforms like Twitter, Reddit, and YouTube.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive reference for understanding internet memes, viral trends, and online culture. The site documents the origins, spread, and cultural impact of memes from TikTok, Twitter/X, Reddit, and other social platforms, providing both database entries and explainer guides for trending phenomena.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Viral meme explanations
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Internet slang and catchphrases
- Twitter/X and Reddit culture
- YouTube and social media trends
- Dance memes and challenges
- Pop culture references
- Mental health humor
- Nostalgia memes
- Breaking Bad references
- Hood culture and 90s nostalgia
- Looksmaxxing and internet subcultures
- Conspiracy theories and viral rumors
- Millennial aesthetics

## TikTok Trends & Dance Memes

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok trend based on BunnaB/YKNiece song with swimming gesture dance
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking millennial burger restaurant cliches and aesthetics

## Exploitable Memes & Image Macros

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl over cat, viral on TikTok/Twitter
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme with Walter White and Jesse Pinkman
